page.overview:
Who is Rudra?

Rudra is a thin-yet-muscular man with distinctive red skin and a nearly-bald head and a white bindi on his forehead. He also sports markings (possibly tattoos) on his head and face, wears ragged, torn pants with numerous pouches and pockets, as well as numerous metallic armbands, chains, bracelets and a pair of large hoop earrings.

Rudra is the brash, arrogant leader of the Crows and thus always eager to get his way with force and violence. Despite being a thug and criminal, however, Rudra has a personal sense of honor and abides by his word once given, and demands everyone in the Crows do the same -- even taking it upon himself to set up the Avatar's entry into the Old Nayshall tournament after they've earned it.

Rudra is also very kind and compassionate to his subordinates, refusing to even go by the title of "Boss". According to Chandi, his tendency to look after the Crows as individuals led each and every one of them to follow him, whether or not he is the strongest person, and they consider him a friend.

His loss to the Avatar shook his confidence enough to go into a major bout of depression, but he later bounces back and states that he will eventually challenge and beat the Avatar, showing a competitive nature.
